title: The outer center-pedal area product in elliptic billiards
actual: Read all five exact searchable PDF pages visually and as text and the exact archive controlling TeX.
proof: For strictly nested confocal ellipses, the signed boundary-tangent outer polygon area times its center pedal signed area is constant when the listed period is not divisible by four. The genuine period divides the listed length and also is not divisible by four. Coprime stars, reversal and repeated traversal scaling r² hold.

Conic polarity puts the successive boundary-tangent intersections in a fixed linear transform of the half-step billiard orbit. The actual center feet on complete boundary tangent lines equal a fixed transform of an edge-vector polygon of a quarter-period-shifted orbit; determinant expansion works also when stepping by two splits the cycle.

The trace period order is the odd q=N/gcd(N,2). The classical Khare–Lakshminarayan–Sukhatme cyclic product-to-sum identity and the dn quarter-period formula give a constant product of traces with the correct phase offsets. The independent meromorphic proof matches the residues at every simple pole. The same pair gives period-four diamond product 32 and rectangle product 50, so there is no unrestricted parity extension.
